name: spotify
description: 🎵 PLAY MUSIC via Spotify. You HAVE Spotify integration - use this tool when user asks to play, hear, listen to ANY music/songs/artists/playlists. Actions: play (starts music), pause, skip/next, current (now playing), search, volume, devices, shuffle, share. Examples: 'play jazz' → action=play query=jazz, 'upbeat 2010s pop' → action=play query='upbeat pop 2010s'.

action.description: Action to perform. 'play' resumes or plays query. 'current' shows what's playing. 'transfer' switches device. 'share' gets shareable link and album art for current track.

query.description: For play/search/queue: what to play or search for. Can be artist, track, album, or playlist name.

device.description: For transfer: device name to play on (e.g., 'Fire TV', 'Living Room', 'iPhone')

type.description: For search: type of content to search for. Use 'show' or 'podcast' for podcasts like Joe Rogan, 'episode' for specific episodes.

state.description: For shuffle: true=on, false=off. Omit to toggle.
